verdicts.typography: Excellent typographic hierarchy and Swiss-style discipline. Mono labels, weight contrast, and rhythm are publication-grade. One minor line-height orphans issue in the hero subhead prevents a perfect score.
verdicts.color: Flawless minimalist execution. Strict single red accent on near-black/white, consistent semantic usage, zero visual noise, and clear WCAG AA contrast throughout.
verdicts.layout: Strong grid alignment and whitespace rhythm. The max-w container, hairline borders, and section spacing are excellent. A minor alignment inconsistency in the stat strip padding/margins is the only visible flaw.
verdicts.components: High-quality component design. The matrix table uses clear iconography and a smart highlighted final column; the accordion list has clean affordances. Lacks visible sticky behavior for the matrix first column in these static shots.
verdicts.responsive: Strong execution on mobile layout and dark mode, but the wide matrix table lacks a visible horizontal scroll indicator or container boundary on mobile (m3-matrix), making it unclear if the user can access the remaining columns.

typography: Tighten line-height or adjust break-points in the hero subheading ('Nobody has assembled them.') to prevent the orphaned 'them.' from sitting alone on its second line, improving vertical rhythm.
layout: Verify that the four stat boxes at the bottom of the hero section have perfectly uniform internal padding and that their outer container margins align precisely with the text column above to eliminate any subtle horizontal drift.
components: Implement and verify `position: sticky; left: 0;` for the 'CAPABILITY' column in the matrix table to ensure it remains visible during horizontal scrolling, which is critical for a 9-column data table.
responsive: Add a distinct overflow-x scroll container with subtle scrollbar styling or 'swipe' affordance for the matrix table on mobile viewports to ensure users know the table extends horizontally beyond the 390px viewport.
